scoring_justification: Checker compares each agent-reported supersaturation and critical radius to the paper's reported gold using relative tolerances (2% for supersaturation, 5% for radius). Recomputing the metric from raw intermediates is not feasible because the agent only writes the final computed values; there are no intermediate raw artifacts to base a recompute on.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for supersaturation and critical radius at the three condensation thresholds.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Taken directly from the paper's tables: supersaturation from the final column of the 'Supersaturation Required ...' tables, radii from the 'Radius ... of drops just large enough to grow' tables.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published numeric results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the paper reports; they serve as the authentic reproduction target.

outputs.description: The computed supersaturation (dimensionless) and critical droplet radius (meters) for each of the three condensation thresholds, compared to the paper-reported reference values within specified relative tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare each reported supersaturation and radius to the paper's gold values using relative tolerances (2% for supersaturation, 5% for radius). Full credit if all six values are within tolerance; partial credit scales linearly with the number of in-tolerance values.

steps.description: Compare agent's supersaturation and critical radius with paper gold using relative tolerances.
